stemMd: A circle of radius 4 cm has an arc subtending 90° at the centre. What is the arc length?
explanationMd: A right angle is one quarter of a full turn. The circumference is 2π × 4 = 8π cm, so the arc length is one quarter of that, 2π cm.

distractorRationale.c: This is the radius, not the quarter-circumference.
distractorRationale.d: This is a sector area with the wrong dimension for length.
